name: Dating Life 2: Emily X Miley
source:
Play as Emily as she goes on her second date with Miley, after they unexpectedly hit it off from a strange and wonderful night before. Is love in the air or just a bit of lust between the two. Can Emily find something special or is this just another night of fun among many.

Your decisions will determine the outcome of the second date and whether there is something more to this relationship.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在上一次奇妙而美好的夜晚，艾米莉与麦莉意外地一拍即合。如今，你将扮演艾米莉，与麦莉进行第二次约会。两人之间弥漫的，究竟是爱情，还是些许欲望？艾米莉能否找到特别的感情，还是这又只是众多寻欢之夜中的一个？

你的决定，将影响第二次约会的结果，以及这段关系能否更进一步。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398670/]Steam[/url]]
